correctness.rationale: Verified the full generator and Hermitian Poisson observable X: hub and each leaf entry of L^dagger X equals -I; the dark-block eigenvalues h+eta+n/gamma are positive and the 2x2 bright-hub block has determinant h(h+eta)-n/(4J^2)>0. Integrating d Tr(X rho)/dt=-Tr rho, monotone survival, and trace decay rigorously gives T=Tr(X rho0) for arbitrary coherent or mixed rho0. AM-GM separates and uniquely optimizes gamma and kappa for w>0; exact gamma=0 decouples dark subspace and yields 2/kappa+(kappa+delta)/(4nJ^2) for pure bright input, not the gamma>0 limit. An independent freshly implemented full Liouvillian inversion corroborated 18 finite parameter/state cases (max absolute error 3.55e-14); the analytic observable, not finite tests, proves arbitrary n.

final_claim: For n>=2, J,kappa,gamma>0 and delta>=0 in the specified uniform star Lindblad model, all leaf-supported trace-one initial densities have exact mean T=(n+1)/kappa+(kappa+gamma+delta)/(4J^2)+n[1-<B|rho0|B>]/gamma; for dark weight w>0, kappa*=2J sqrt(n+1), gamma*=2J sqrt(nw), while at gamma=0 the pure bright state has a distinct finite mean and all w>0 states are never fully trapped.
limitations: Uniform J star, positive common leaf dephasing and hub trapping only; no competing recombination, disorder or higher absorption-time moments.
The independent finite Liouvillian checks corroborate but do not prove all n, all positive rates.
